_doc: E9 cases, labelled BEFORE any run. expect 'pictures': the user wants to SEE something, which only show_pictures puts on the screen. 'web' video asks: videos reach the card through search_web (small-model-tools.md 8.11), so search_web is right and show_pictures is not. Cases with 'picture' attach that photo (fixtures/pictures, freely licensed Commons files; never a search engine's results) after the user's text, as the pond does; their 'arg' patterns check the call says what is IN the picture, not 'this'. accept: families that also count as right.
